test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A: lost all his teeth

B: cannot eat hard food

C: he has

D: consequently, he
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (3)** i.e. **CADB**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "he has," which is correctly indicated by **part (C).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "lost all his teeth" **(CA)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what he has lost.
 
• **The next part,** "consequently, he" starts the explanation about the consequence, indicated by **(D).**
 
• **Ending with **"cannot eat hard food" **(DB)** completes the sentence by stating the consequence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **CADB.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (BDAC):** This option starts with "consequently, he cannot eat hard food" which fragments the sentence and loses its logical flow.
 
• **Option 2 (DACB):** This option starts with "lost all his teeth consequently, he" which makes the sentence incomplete and awkward.
 
• **Option 4 (ADBC):** This option starts with "lost all his teeth consequently, he" which is not a proper beginning and disrupts the sentence's structure.
